title: AutoB2G: Agentic Simulation and Reinforcement Learning for Spatio-Temporal Grid-Interactive Building Control
abstract: arXiv:2603.26005v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Grid-interactive building control can improve demand-side flexibility, but realistic evaluation requires coordinated co-simulation of buildings, reinforcement learning (RL), and distribution grids. Translating user intent into executable co-simulation workflows is labor-intensive, requiring the manual integration and configuration of heterogeneous simulators and interfaces. We introduce AutoB2G, a grid-aware building--grid co-simulation environment integrating CityLearn V2 with Pandapower and OpenDSS. translated_title: AutoB2G：面向时空电网交互建筑控制的智能体仿真与强化学习
translated_abstract: 电网交互建筑控制可以提升需求侧灵活性，但现实评估需要对建筑、强化学习（RL）和配电网进行协调的联合仿真。将用户意图转化为可执行的联合仿真工作流十分耗费人力，需要对异构仿真器和接口进行手动集成与配置。我们提出了 AutoB2G，这是一个具备电网感知能力的建筑—电网联合仿真环境，将 CityLearn V2 与 Pandapower 和 OpenDSS 相集成。它支持平衡与三相不平衡电网仿真，并提供广泛的电网侧评估指标。AutoB2G 将仿真组件组织为有向无环图（DAG），显式编码模块间的依赖关系与执行顺序，以实现依赖感知的检索与组合。基于这一结构，我们开发了基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体框架，可自动检索、组合并执行（联合仿真工作流……摘要内容在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 AutoB2G，一个将 CityLearn V2 与 Pandapower/OpenDSS 集成的电网感知建筑—电网联合仿真环境，通过以有向无环图（DAG）组织仿真组件，并借助基于大语言模型的智能体框架自动检索、组合和执行联合仿真工作流，从而支持基于强化学习的时空电网交互建筑控制。
en_tdlr: AutoB2G presents a grid-aware building-grid co-simulation environment integrating CityLearn V2 with Pandapower and OpenDSS, organizing simulation components as a DAG and leveraging an LLM-based agentic framework to automatically retrieve, compose, and execute co-simulation workflows for reinforcement learning-based spatio-temporal grid-interactive building control.
